verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph change notifications are a first-party mechanism that lets apps receive alerts when resources are created, updated, or deleted, and rich notifications can include the changed resource data. The pack never shows that these alerts are delivered as registrable outbound HTTP callbacks, nor that they cover Outlook mail specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation of subscription registration with an HTTP notification URL (webhook endpoint), endpoint validation and subscription lifetime/renewal details, Outlook mail/event resource coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Change notifications enable applications to receive alerts when a Microsoft Graph resource they're interested in changes; that is, created, updated, or deleted.
Change notifications that include the resource data of the object that changed.
